justification: Both surfaces are organized into horizontal registers containing carved symbols, but panel A shows a dense column of abstract geometric glyph-blocks with no figural imagery, while panel B depicts naturalistic standing human figures with raised arms, staffs, and small objects arranged in narrative scenes. The rendering conventions and content type (script-like abstraction versus figural narrative) differ fundamentally, so the correspondence is limited to the generic notion of registers of symbols rather than any specific shared motif or relationship.
